memory_update.text: ECVT should remain a priority underfollowed candidate for the sulphuric-acid node because it is a US-listed, mid-cap, direct sulfuric-acid regeneration and virgin-acid supplier with mining, agriculture, battery, and industrial end-market exposure.
ITFS is a high-relevance small-cap/OTCQX discovery candidate due to its explicit Conda sulfuric-acid dependency and amended Rio Tinto/Kennecott supply agreement through 2029.

The strongest second-order mapping is not only acid producers, but firms with secured smelter-acid offtake or logistics assets that can move replacement acid into phosphate, copper, and nickel processing routes.

Need stronger verification for logistics names: direct sulfuric-acid cargo exposure, acid-service fleet capability, customer names, and whether route dislocation is material enough to affect earnings.
